action:
After a standard system update you need to restart any running Java
applications to make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that the JGSS component of OpenJDK 8 did not correctly
authenticate users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to read
or modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114939)

Nicholas Carlini discovered that the JSSE component of OpenJDK 8 did not
correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to read or modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114940)

It was discovered that the Hotspot component of OpenJDK 8 did not correctly
authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a
denial of service or to modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114943)

Alexander Dezhinov, Stanislav Dukhin, Nikita Kozlov, and Binbin Xu
discovered that the Core Java Libraries component of OpenJDK 8 did not
correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114944)

It was discovered that the Compiler component of OpenJDK 8 did not
correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to read or modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114946)

In addition to security fixes, the updated packages contain bug fixes, new
features, and possibly incompatible changes.

Please see the following for more information:
https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-11-17
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in OpenJDK 8.
title: OpenJDK 8 vulnerabilities
